title: Finish Calculator
notePrimer: Apply primer before top coats for better adhesion.
noteStain: Sand lightly between stain coats. Wipe excess immediately.
notePaint: Use a foam roller for panels; brush for edges and details.
noteVarnish: Allow each varnish coat to cure fully before sanding back.
noteOil: Danish oil penetrates the grain; wipe off surplus after 20 min.
noteLacquer: Apply lacquer in thin, even passes in a dust-free environment.
